title: The Pink and Mint Christmas Eve Box for Kids

intro: Christmas Eve boxes are my favourite tradition because they are tiny and they buy you one calm evening. This one has an engraved wooden box, pink gingerbread pajamas, fuzzy pink slippers, a snow globe mug, The Night Before Christmas board book and a pink plush fox. Pajamas on, cocoa, story, bed.
